description: This file contains base OpenTelemetry tracing decorators and utilities for the Pipecat project, including classes and functions for tracing class methods and functions with different attachment strategies.

classes.name: AttachmentStrategy
classes.description: Enum controlling how spans are attached to the trace hierarchy (CHILD, LINK, NONE).

classes.name: Traceable
classes.description: Base class for objects that can be traced with OpenTelemetry, providing foundational tracing capabilities.

methods.name: traced
methods.description: Decorator to add tracing to an async function within a Traceable class, supporting custom span names and attachment strategies.

methods.name: traceable
methods.description: Class decorator to make a class traceable by inheriting from Traceable, enabling tracing for class methods.
